source.title: Increased Drop Rate
source.description:
Now that we know my inventions work as stand alone devices, the next logical step in innovation is to improve reusability and quality of life! I don't think either of us wants to throw a fist full of gold away each and every time we want to port over a puddle.

As always, I have an idea.

Belts are a woefully underappreciated piece of equipment, and are convenient to reach. It makes sense to enhance these with reusable gadgets, but I need a few to practice with. Go steal a few.
source.progress:
I am all set to begin tinkering the moment you bring me back some belts.

What? No, I am not going to use my own!
source.completion:
While you were away, I managed to finish ALL THREE of my schematics for the belt tinkers! That's both very impressive for me and quite depressing for you.

I also realized that we're very lucky our chaos hasn't earned us more attention from these pesky humans. As such, I don't think I need these belts at all, my focus now is going to be plotting my escape. I'll still take them anyway to start a collection; wouldn't want to get caught with my pants down.
